text: Computer vision is a type of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One common task is image recognition, which means a computer can identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a person. Another important task is object detection. This allows a computer to find and locate several objects in one image at the same time. These technologies have many useful applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect people or other vehicles. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and shopping apps, making our lives safer and easier.
